title: Trust no input
description:
Make the server refuse moves that are impossible.

```
input move (1, 0) at speed 5   -> accepted, x = 5
input move (10, 0)             -> direction too long, normalised
input from tick 90 at tick 100 -> too old, ignored
input with dt 0.5 (expected 0.016) -> refused
```
hints: `double len{std::hypot(dx, dy)}; if (len > 1) { dx /= len; dy /= len; }` (lesson 6.01).
Never use the client's `dt` for movement; use the server's fixed step, and only compare to catch cheats.
requirements: The server owns the position; the client only sends a direction and its tick.
Clamp direction length to 1, refuse inputs older than 10 ticks or with a wrong time step.
Count refused inputs per player, and log a warning after 5.
stretch: Check against walls on the server so a client cannot walk through them.
